questions.prakriti: Have you been assessed by an Ayurvedic practitioner for your Prakriti (body constitution)? If yes, please tell us what was recorded.
questions.vikriti: Has an Ayurvedic practitioner previously identified any current imbalance or Vikriti? If yes, please describe what was recorded.
questions.sara: Has your tissue quality or Sara been assessed by an Ayurvedic practitioner? If yes, please tell us the recorded assessment.
questions.samhanana: Has your body build or Samhanana been assessed? If yes, please describe the recorded assessment.
questions.pramana: If previously assessed, do you have any recorded measurements such as height, weight, or other Pramana measurements?
questions.satmya: Are there foods, routines, medicines, or environmental conditions that you tolerate particularly well or poorly?
questions.sattva: If previously assessed by a practitioner, has your Sattva or mental strength been recorded? If yes, please describe it.
questions.ahara_shakti: How would you describe your appetite and ability to digest food? For example, poor, moderate, or good.
questions.vyayama_shakti: How much physical activity or exercise can you comfortably do? For example, low, moderate, or high.
questions.vaya: What is your age, and if previously assessed, was your age-related Ayurvedic assessment recorded?
questions.ahara_vihara: Please describe your usual diet, daily routine, sleep pattern, physical activity, and other important lifestyle habits.
